notes: ἦσαν παραδεδομένοι is split under rule 2, the ASV writing had been for the auxiliary and committed for the participle; contrast 14:7, where the periphrasis is collapsed and ἦσαν keeps only its subject.
κἀκεῖθεν takes and thence as one unit headed on the adverbial element under rule 55.
τοῦ before θεοῦ is unrepresented under rules 21 and 23, the case preposition staying with the noun.
